items.title: 3 Types of Hobbies
items.content_snippet: Most people have one hobby and wonder why they still feel flat. Sabine Sonnentag at the University of Mannheim studies what actually restores people after work, and she found four separate mechanisms: detaching mentally, relaxing, mastering something new, and having control over your own time. items.title: GPT-6 Astra cracked a DEF CON puzzle
items.content_snippet: Ben Davis put GPT-6 Astra to the test with puzzles he and his friends spent days working on at DEF CON. Given the same official hint his team received, it solved a Rubik’s cube puzzle three out of three times.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra with Peter Gostev
items.content_snippet: Peter Gostev shares his first impressions of GPT-6 Astra, from building a 3D London that moves through different historical eras to improving an app with around 150,000 lines of code. He discusses more natural feedback, greater reliability, and taking on complex tasks with less supervision.
